line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: Lyra. Wake, child. The forest is crying out.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: Elder? Your voice... it's coming from the rune stones.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: The Withering has come back. A blight from the old roots, turning the forest's creatures against it. Snails, boars, even the bees... their eyes burn red now.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: My mother held it back once. Before she...

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: She was the last Warden of these woods. Her legacy is all that has kept the blight asleep. It is fading.

option.text: Then I'll finish what she started.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: A Warden is not born, Lyra. A Warden is made, step by step, deed by deed.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: Your mother left you her sword and her name. What you build with them will be your own legacy.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: Go east, through the Whispering Woods and the Shadowed Hollow, to the heart of the forest. The blight's root is there: Grimtusk, the great boar it took first.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: Free the creatures you can. Touch the rune stones on your way: they will remember you, should you fall.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: I'll try. For her, and for the forest.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: I won't fall. For her, and for the forest.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Run with {$left} and {$right}. Jump with {$jump}: hold it to jump higher, let go early for a short hop.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Hold {$down} and jump to drop through a wooden plank.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Strike with {$attack}. Your blade swings twice: a creature caught by both falls quickly.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Pots hide coins. Break them.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: A boar paws the ground before it charges. Jump over it, or land on its back.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: The blight has soured the water. Do not touch it. The roots still carry those who wait for them.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: It's getting dark. The hollow is under that hill: the blight runs deepest there.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Your mother's lantern still burns. Keep it close.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Down the shaft lies the hollow's heart. The way out climbs from its far end.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Here the bees hunt. They find their way around the rock to whoever they hear.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: The sky's gone red. It's close now.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: Whatever you meet in there, Lyra: it was once a friend of these woods.

line.speaker: Grimtusk
line.text: WARDEN'S WHELP. I SMELL HER ON YOU.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: Grimtusk. You guarded these woods with her. Fight it!

line.speaker: Grimtusk
line.text: THE ROOTS ARE MINE. THE FOREST IS MINE. YOU WILL FEED THEM, AS SHE DID.

line.speaker: Rune
line.text: Make it charge into the walls. Stunned, it is open.

line.speaker: Grimtusk
line.text: ...the light. I remember the light. Warden... thank you.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: The blight is broken. Listen: the forest is singing again.

line.speaker: Elder Rowan
line.text: You did not inherit a legacy today, Lyra. You built one.

line.speaker: Lyra
line.text: Then it's only the beginning.
